scope: Workspace production dependencies, including build tooling dependencies; not a browser bundle reachability verdict.

remainingHighOrCritical.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections

remainingModerate.title: Glob: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal
minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification

assessment.zod: Zod 3 remains required by @vee-validate/zod and zod-defaults in the shared form package. Current lock/unlock screens use string schemas; business forms use Ant Design Form. The oversized constrained collection advisory remains unresolved for consumers of the generic shared form API. A complete fix requires a coordinated Zod 4 form-adapter migration; no forced major-version override or audit suppression is applied.
assessment.glob: Used by source/build tooling (archive generation, PWA build tooling and file cleanup). It is not executed in the static browser deployment. All supported same-major updates were applied; fixing the remaining advisory requires migrating upstream consumers to glob >=14.0.2.
assessment.minimatch: Used by lint/build tooling. It is not an HTTP service in the static browser deployment. Remaining versions require coordinated upgrades to minimatch >=11.0.1, including consumers pinned to v9.
